summary: Lee Enterprises filed an 8-K disclosing a Management Agreement with Hoffmann Media Group, under which Lee will manage certain newspaper publications and digital properties owned by Hoffmann. The initial term runs June 1, 2026 to May 31, 2031, with automatic one-year renewals. Hoffmann will pay a fixed quarterly fee of $135,000 plus a variable fee of 20% of EBITDA from publications acquired after start date. Lee will provide operational management services and shared services at cost. The board approved the Agreement under related-party transaction policies; David Hoffmann (majority shareholder and Chairman) recused himself. This is not a special situation—it is a service agreement with a related party.
